messages:
Riley (Finance): Morning — discovered two invoices for EchoLabs from last night's batch. One PDF total = $11,200, the other = $8,450. Looks like reserved_capacity discount (-$2,750) missing on the lower one.
Dee (Billing): I see ids 2026-05-EL-0221 and 2026-05-EL-0221-dup in the ledger export. Both have same invoice_id field but different line sets.
Kato (Billing-ops): InvoiceBot flagged a mismatch at render time and quarantined the duplicates.
InvoiceBot: job=invoice.batch run=1796000000 status=partial_fail duplicates=1 missing_lines=1 quarantined=true artifact=/tmp/echolabs_diff_179600.csv
Maya (Engineering): Looking into compose logs — noticed a transient DB connection reset at 02:07 that caused one worker to abort while writing line items, then a retry emitted a second PDF without the credit line.
Riley (Finance): Can we regenerate only EchoLabs? Need corrected PDF + credit memo before EOD.
Dee (Billing): We have a targeted recompose endpoint. I'll queue it and void the quarantined copy so customer doesn't see it.
Maya (Engineering): Recompose done: 2026-05-EL-0221-R1 generated with reserved_capacity row present. Uploaded sanitized CSV to artifacts.
InvoiceBot: artifact=/artifacts/BLG-6001/echolabs_recompose_1796003000.csv status=uploaded
Kato (Billing-ops): Voided 2026-05-EL-0221-dup and annotated ledger: "voided - missing reserved_capacity line due to transient compose failure". Drafted credit memo for $2,750.
Riley (Finance): Approved credit memo. Please CC AE on customer comms.
Dee (Billing): Sent corrected invoice + credit memo to customer; AE cc'd. Added runbook note: when render abort occurs, quarantine PDFs until recompose completes.
Maya (Engineering): Adding post-deploy guard: if worker error occurs during compose, block publish and trigger recompose queue. Also adding alert for duplicate invoice_id > 0.
Riley (Finance): Thanks team — closing once AE confirms signature. Reopen if any follow-up.
_meta: generated_for_dataset: finance invoice generation failures; style: short Slack thread with bot logs and targeted recompose actions
